rationale: Initial pilot exposed repeated-change interpretation errors, missing correct candidates and correct candidates lost by field plurality. Test the planned bounded diversity/selection ablation.

roles.instruction: Before calculating, use short code comments to bind each required output to its definition in the question. Resolve signs, scales, timing and whether a change is applied once or repeatedly from the stated wording. Do not introduce an unstated convention. Then compute every output in one complete program.

Derive the solution independently using explicit intermediate states or cash flows. Where applicable, cross-check it with a separate algebraic relation or conservation equation whose assumptions follow from the question. Return one complete program with all required outputs.

Audit the quantity definitions before solving. Distinguish amounts from rates, signed changes from magnitudes, and one-time changes from recurring changes. Track the state at each requested time and use only scenario rules actually stated. Return a complete independently derived program, with brief comments explaining the output definitions.
